name: Copper Star Home Medical Supplies
old_description: Copper Star Home Medical has been Phoenix’s locally trusted home medical equipment store for over 22 years. With the largest medical supply showroom in Arizona, if you need it, there’s a good chance we have it. Whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing a chronic condition, or looking for equipment that makes daily life safer and more comfortable at home, our Phoenix store has what you need. That includes power lift chairs, home hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers and rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and home oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath and shower safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and aids to daily living.
about:
Copper Star Home Medical Supplies operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it has served the local community for over 22 years. The company runs what it describes as the largest medical supply showroom in the state from a location on East Bell Road near Highway 51, with additional stores in Tempe, Mesa, and Surprise. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a durable medical equipment (DME) retailer, offering a broad range of products for sale or short‑term and long‑term rental. Inventory includes power lift chairs, home hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers and rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and stationary oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath and shower safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and aids to daily living. Every item in the showroom is fully assembled and available for hands‑on trial before purchase or rental. The company accepts FSA and HSA payments and works with major insurance providers including Medicare, Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona, and several regional health plans.

Customers include patients recovering from surgery, individuals managing chronic respiratory, cardiac, or mobility conditions, seasonal "snowbird" residents, caregivers, and healthcare professionals who refer patients for equipment. The Phoenix metro’s growing 65‑and‑older population and proximity to facilities such as HonorHealth Deer Valley Medical Center and Mayo Clinic Hospital drive demand for post‑discharge and in‑home care equipment.

Copper Star emphasizes its local roots, the breadth of its showroom, and a service model built on personal consultation — helping each visitor decide whether to rent or buy, navigating insurance coverage, and providing same‑day pickup for in‑stock items. The company positions itself as a convenient, knowledgeable resource for Phoenix‑area residents and visitors needing reliable home medical equipment.
